mechanism: Both drugs are nephrotoxic and can cause or potentiate renal impairment; valganciclovir is converted to ganciclovir which is renally cleared, and zoledronic acid accumulates in renal failure, increasing toxicity risk.
action: Monitor renal function (serum creatinine, eGFR) closely; adjust zoledronic acid dosing based on creatinine clearance; ensure adequate hydration; consider alternative antivirals if renal function deteriorates.
